soc.altitude_acclimatization_gap.measurement_fix: gap_m = alt(venue) - A_vis, where A_vis = sum_k w_k*alt(venue_k)/sum_k w_k over the visitor's matches in the 60 days before kickoff (w_k=0.5^(days_ago/20)); if no match in window use altitude of the visitor's home venue. x = max(0, gap_m-500)/1000 (km above 500 m). Fit goal-difference ~ ... + beta*x (plus separate beta for 2H if minute data exist) on all matches since 2000 with team home-advantage and rating terms, ridge-shrink beta to 0 with k=50 matches above 500 m. As-of kickoff-1h; altitude values are static venue constants.

soc.destination_club_feasibility.measurement_fix: Per candidate club c: wage_room = max(0, 0.70*latest revenue - wage bill - player wage - fee/contract_years) in EUR (0.70 = UEFA squad-cost ratio; league cap headroom for MLS/Saudi); need = 1 if club's best player at the position has rating below the player's by >0.5 SD of the club's squad rating, else 0; pref = 1 if a tier-1 outlet reported the club's interest in the previous 30 days (timestamped). soc.host_venue_relocation_risk.measurement_fix: For region r with n_r scheduled matches: base per-match relocation/cancellation hazard h0 = (relocated or cancelled matches)/(scheduled matches) in World Cups, Euros, Copa Americas and Olympics since 1990, Beta(0.5,50)-shrunk; region-level decision probability q_r from a dated news-flag ladder (0 none, 1 official statement of discussion, 2 formal FIFA review) with q_r = 0.002/0.03/0.20 priors, updated by Bayes with timestamped reports. soc.positional_slot_competition.measurement_fix: Per federation and position group g, quota Q_g = mean number of that position in the coach's last 2 final squads (round to integer, spread from the federation's last 3 tournaments). Selection score s_i = 0.4*callup_share (soc.national_team_call_up_history) + 0.3*club minutes share in last 10 matches (decay 0.9) + 0.2*international minutes share + 0.1*fit indicator, weights fitted by logistic regression on past final squads (leave-one-tournament-out). soc.pre_ceremony_leak_signal.measurement_fix: Event log of each report (timestamp, source tier, named winner). Per tier t estimate hit rate h_t = P(report names the eventual winner) with Beta(2,1) prior updated on past leaks, and false-report rate f_t = 1-h_t over the same sample; LR_t = h_t/(f_t/(K-1)) with K candidates.
